newsitem.title: USA: First Northern Capital to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: First Northern Capital to buy back shares.

text.p: First Northern Capital Corp said Friday its board of directors approved a stock repurchase plan that will begin immediately and will conclude no later than April 18.
The plan, which has been approved by regulatory authorities, calls for the repurchase of five percent of shares outstanding, or about 219,057 shares.
First Northern said the shares will be purchased at prevailing market prices from time to time depending upon market conditions.
The repurchased stock will become treasury shares and are expected to be used for general operations.

"The board of directors recognizes the continuation of a stock repurchase plan as an attractive investment alternative for the corporation and its stockholders, and is consistent with our commitment to enhance long-term stockholder value," Michael Meeuwsen, president, said in a statment.
In March, First Northern Capital, the holding company for First Northern Savings Bank, had authorized the repurchase of 228,467 shares, or five percent of shares outstanding at that time.
